name: CallElimCorrect.substOldPostSubset
proof:

theorem substOldPostSubset:
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression)
    (substOld h2 (Lambda.LExpr.fvar m h1 ty) post)).Subset
    (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression) post ++ [h1]) := by

    List.mem_singleton, Classical.or_iff_not_imp_right]
  intro Hin Hx

name: Core.InitsUpdatesComm
proof:
theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro hu hi
  have hl := UpdateStatesLength hu
  have hl' := InitStatesLength hi
  have hn := InitStatesNotDefined hi
  refine ⟨_, rfl, updatedStatesInit hl'
    (UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' hn hu) (InitStatesNodup hi), ?_⟩
  simp [InitStatesUpdated hi, UpdateStatesUpdated hu, updatedStates]
  rw [updatedStatesComm]
  · exact updatedStatesUpdate hl (updatedStatesDefMonotone (UpdateStatesDefined' hu))
  · simp [List.unzip_zip hl, List.unzip_zip hl']
    intro k hk hk'
    cases (hn k hk' ▸ UpdateStatesDefined hu k hk)

name: fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus'
proof:
lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  funext x₀
  apply (inner_self_eq_zero' (𝕜 := ℝ)).mp
  refine le_antisymm ?_ real_inner_self_nonneg'
  by_contra! hpos
  have hc := Continuous.inner' (𝕜 := ℝ) f (fun _ => f x₀) hf continuous_const
  obtain ⟨φ, hsupp, hcompact, hsmooth, hrange, hcenter⟩ :=
    exists_contDiff_tsupport_subset (n := ⊤)
      ((isOpen_lt continuous_const hc).mem_nhds hpos)
  refine ((hsmooth.continuous.mul hc).integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero
    (μ := μ) hcompact.mul_right (fun x => ?_)
    (mul_ne_zero (hcenter.trans_ne one_ne_zero) hpos.ne')).ne' ?_
  · by_cases hx : φ x = 0
    · simp [hx]
    · exact mul_nonneg (hrange (Set.mem_range_self x)).1 (hsupp (subset_tsupport φ hx)).le
  · simpa only [Pi.mul_apply, inner_smul_right'] using
      hg (fun x => φ x • f x₀)
        (IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨hsmooth, hcompact⟩ contDiff_const)

name: Electromagnetism.ElectromagneticPotential.time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema
proof:
lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hA3 : ContDiff ℝ 3 A := hA.of_le (ENat.LEInfty.out)
  have hdJ := hJ.differentiable (by decide)
  have hEs := fun j => electricField_apply_contDiff_space (n := 2) (c := 𝓕.c) (i := j) hA3 t
  have hEd := fun j k => Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j) k
  have hBc := fun j => magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff (n := 2) (c := 𝓕.c) A
    hA3 (j, i)
  have hBt := fun j => Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j) (hBc j) x t
  have hJt := LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time
    (c := 𝓕.c) hdJ x i t
  have hgd := congrArg (fun f => fderiv ℝ f x (Space.basis i))
    (funext fun y => ((isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h t y).1)
  unfold Space.div at hgd
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, fderiv_fun_sum (fun j _ => hEd j j x),
    fderiv_mul_const (LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space
      hdJ t x), _root_.sum_apply, _root_.smul_apply,
    ← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis] at hgd
  conv_lhs =>
    enter [1, s]
    rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time
      (hA.of_le (ENat.LEInfty.out)) x), time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
  rw [Time.deriv_eq,
    (((HasFDerivAt.fun_sum fun j _ => (hBt j).hasFDerivAt).const_mul _).fun_sub
      (hJt.hasFDerivAt.const_mul _)).fderiv]
  simp only [_root_.sub_apply, _root_.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, _root_.sum_apply,
    ← Time.deriv_eq, fun j => Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv (i := j) (hBc j) t x,
    time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix A (hA.of_le (ENat.LEInfty.out)),
    fun j => Space.fun_deriv_sub (u := j) _ _ (hEd i j) (hEd j i),
    fun j => Space.deriv_commute (u := j) (v := i) _ (hEs j),
    Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hgd, mul_sub, ← mul_assoc, ← div_eq_mul_inv]
  rw [mul_comm 𝓕.μ₀ 𝓕.ε₀, ← FreeSpace.c_sq]
  congr 2
  rw [FreeSpace.c_sq, div_mul_eq_mul_div₀, mul_div_mul_right _ _ 𝓕.μ₀_ne_zero]

name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time
proof:
lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let c := [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF
  have h : (mulLinearMap ∘ₗ mulLinearMap.flip c).compr₂ (ι.toLinearMap ∘ₗ timeOrderF) =
      mulLinearMap.compr₂ (ι.toLinearMap ∘ₗ mulLinearMap c ∘ₗ timeOrderF) := by
    apply LinearMap.ext_basis ofCrAnListFBasis ofCrAnListFBasis
    intro s t
    simp only [LinearMap.compr₂_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.flip_apply,
      mulLinearMap_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, ofListBasis_eq_ofList]
    let l1 := List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
      ((s ++ t).insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel) ++
      List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) s
    let l2 := List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) t ++
      List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)
        ((s ++ t).insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel)
    have ht (l : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) (hl : ∀ z ∈ l,
        crAnTimeOrderRel φ z ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel z φ) :
        crAnTimeOrderList ((s ++ l) ++ t) = (l1 ++ l) ++ l2 := by
      simpa only [crAnTimeOrderList, l1, l2, List.append_assoc] using
        insertionSort_of_eq_list crAnTimeOrderRel φ s l t hl
    have h1 := ht [φ, ψ] (by simp [hφψ, hψφ])
    have h2 := ht [ψ, φ] (by simp [hφψ, hψφ])
    have h0 := ht [] (List.forall_mem_nil _)
    simp only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, List.append_nil] at h0 h1 h2
    trans crAnTimeOrderSign (s ++ φ :: ψ :: t) •
      (ι (ofCrAnListF l1) * ι c * ι (ofCrAnListF l2))
    · simp only [c, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton, superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF,
        mul_sub, sub_mul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc,
        ← ofCrAnListF_append, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, List.append_assoc,
        map_sub, map_smul, ofList_singleton, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF,
        h1, h2,
        ← crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ]
      simp only [ofCrAnListF_append, ofCrAnListF_cons, map_mul, ofCrAnListF_nil, mul_one, mul_assoc, smul_sub]
      rw [smul_comm]
    · rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ),
        mul_assoc, ← map_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append]
      rw [← h0]
      by_cases hq : 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ = 𝓕.crAnStatistics φ
      · rw [← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
        simp only [c, crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ hq,
          map_mul, map_smul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm]
      · simp only [c, ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic (Ne.symm hq), zero_mul, smul_zero, map_mul]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun (DFunLike.congr_fun h a) b

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.progress
proof:
lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  let der' := der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var mem => cases mem
  case abs | tabs => left; constructor; exact der'.wf.2.1
  case app t₁ _ _ t₂ l r ih_l ih_r =>
    specialize ih_l rfl
    specialize ih_r rfl
    grind only [→ l.canonical_form_abs, → wf, → Red.abs,
      → Red.appₗ (t₁ := t₁), → Red.appᵣ (t₂ := t₂)]
  case tapp d _ ih =>
    cases der'.wf.2.1 with | tapp _ lc =>
      specialize ih rfl
      grind only [→ d.canonical_form_tabs, → Red.tabs, → Red.tapp]
  case let' ih _ =>
    specialize ih rfl
    grind only [body_let.mp der'.wf.2.1, → Red.let_body, → Red.let_bind]
  case inl | inr | sub =>
    rename_i ih
    specialize ih rfl
    grind only [Value.inl, Value.inr, → Red.inl, → Red.inr]
  case case t₁ _ _ _ _ _ _ d _ _ ih _ _ =>
    specialize ih rfl
    grind only [body_case.mp der'.wf.2.1, → d.canonical_form_sum, cases Value, → Red.case (t₁ := t₁),
      → Red.case_inl, → Red.case_inr]

name: Cslib.SKI.parallelReduction_diamond
proof:
theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂
  case refl => exact ⟨a₂, h₂, .refl _⟩
  all_goals cases h₂
  case par.par iha ihb _ _ ha' hb' =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hx'⟩ := iha ha'
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hy'⟩ := ihb hb'
    exact ⟨_, .par hx hy, .par hx' hy'⟩
  case' par.red_I | par.red_K | par.red_S => apply symm
  case par.red_I | red_I.par =>
    cases I_irreducible _ (by assumption)
    exact ⟨_, by assumption, .red_I _⟩
  case par.red_K | red_K.par =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ (by assumption)
    exact ⟨_, hx, .red_K ..⟩
  case par.red_S hb _ _ _ _ _ | red_S.par hb =>
    obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ (by assumption)
    exact ⟨_, .par (.par hx hb) (.par hy hb), .red_S ..⟩
  all_goals exact ⟨_, .refl _, by constructor <;> assumption⟩

name: Cslib.CCS.bisimilarity_congr_choice
proof:
theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  rw [HomBisimilarity.symm_simulation]
  refine ⟨ChoiceBisim, .choice h, ⟨?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · grind only [ChoiceBisim, → Bisimilarity.symm]
  · rintro _ _ (h | h) μ s' ht
    case' choice => cases ht <;> rename_i ht
    case choiceR => exact ⟨s', Tr.choiceR ht, .bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
    all_goals
      apply (h.follow_fst ht).imp
      intro t
      refine And.imp ?_ ChoiceBisim.bisim
      first | exact id | exact Tr.choiceL

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius
proof:
theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ : ∃ g : BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) i.castSucc, g ∈ Set.univ ∧
      (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g.val).ncard =
        fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f :=
    Nat.sInf_mem (Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty)
  let Y := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g.val
  let hY := Y.toFinite
  let q := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps
  let F := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) (i := ⟨i, lt_trans i.isLt (Nat.lt_of_add_right_lt h_ℓ_add_R_rate)⟩) steps
    (fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps)
  have hc : hammingDist f g.val ≤ Y.ncard * 2 ^ steps := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (hY.toFinset ×ˢ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (2 ^ steps)))).card := by
        apply Finset.card_le_card_of_surjOn (fun p => F p.1 p.2)
        intro x hx
        refine ⟨(q x, pointToIterateQuotientIndex 𝔽q β
          i.castSucc steps h_i_add_steps x), ?_, ?_⟩
        · exact Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hY.mem_toFinset.mpr
            ⟨x, rfl, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2⟩, Finset.mem_univ _⟩
        · exact (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps
            x (q x)).mp rfl
      _ = _ := by
        simp only [Finset.card_product, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin,
          ← Y.ncard_eq_toFinset_card hY]
  unfold hammingClose
  apply lt_of_le_of_lt (mul_le_mul_left'
    (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g.val g.property) 2)
  apply WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mpr
  apply Nat.lt_succ_of_le
  have h := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ steps)
    (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mp h_fw_dist_lt))
  simp only [← hg, Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.sub_mul, ← Nat.pow_add,
    Nat.sub_add_eq,
    Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le'
      (h_i_add_steps.trans (Nat.le_add_right ℓ 𝓡))),
    Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' h_i_add_steps)] at h
  exact (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hc).trans h

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fold_advances_evaluation_poly
proof:
theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only [fold]
  intro y
  let x := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β ⟨i, fin_ℓ_lt_r (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) i⟩ 1 h_i_succ_lt y
  have hx : (x 1).val = (x 0).val + 1 := by
    simp only [x, qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (Nat.succ_le_of_lt i.isLt) y,
      Fin2ToF2, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, zero_smul, one_smul,
      Submodule.coe_add, Submodule.coe_zero, zero_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
    exact add_comm _ _
  have hq (k : Fin 2) := congrArg Subtype.val
    (generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (Nat.succ_le_of_lt i.isLt) (x k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩)
  simp only [x, iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at hq
  simp only [evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, eval_comp, ←hq]
  calc
    _ = (1 - r_chal) * (evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val + r_chal * (oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val := by rw [hx]; ring1
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
        Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C, Fin.eta,
        add_mul, mul_assoc, mul_sum, sum_add_distrib]
      rfl

name: interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
proof:
theorem interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
    (hC_proximityGapAffineLines : e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat
      (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) (C := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε))
    (h_interleaved_gaps : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 1 →
      e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat (F := F)
        (A := InterleavedSymbol A (Fin m)) (ι := ι) (C := MC ^⋈ (Fin m)) e ε) :
    ∀ (ϑ : ℕ), (hϑ_gt_0 : ϑ > 0) → δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat (F := F) (A := A)
      (ι := ι) (C := MC) (ϑ := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε) := by
  intro ϑ hϑ
  induction ϑ, hϑ using Nat.le_induction with
  | base =>
    intro u hp
    have hu : u = finMapTwoWords (u 0) (u 1) := by
      funext i
      match i with
      | 0 => rfl
      | 1 => rfl
    rw [hu]
    apply hC_proximityGapAffineLines (u 0) (u 1)
    simpa only [multilinearCombine₁_eq_affineLineEvaluation (u := u),
      prob_uniform_singleton_finFun_eq (F := F)
        (P := fun r => Δ₀(affineLineEvaluation (u 0) (u 1) r, MC) ≤ e), Nat.cast_one, ENNReal.coe_one, ENNReal.coe_natCast, one_mul] using hp
  | succ n hn ih =>
    intro u hp
    have hs := prob_split_last_uniform_sampling_of_finFun
      (P := multilinearCombine_affineComb_split_last_close MC u e)
    simp only [multilinearCombine_affineComb_split_last_close, ← Fin.init_def,
      ← multilinearCombine_recursive_form (u := u)] at hs
    apply CA_split_rowwise_implies_CA MC u e
    apply h_interleaved_gaps (2 ^ n) Nat.one_le_two_pow
    apply lt_of_lt_of_le (prob_R_star_gt_threshold (ε := ε) MC u e (hs ▸ hp))
    apply Pr_le_Pr_of_implies
    intro r hr
    exact correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor MC ih u ⟨r, hr⟩

name: putnam_1964_a4
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n) := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  let f n (k : Fin 4) : Set.Icc B T := ⟨u (n + k), hB _⟩
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, he⟩ :=
    Set.finite_univ.exists_lt_map_eq_of_forall_mem (f := f) (fun _ => Set.mem_univ _)
  have eqs : ∀ m, f (i + m) = f (j + m) := Nat.rec he (fun m ih => by
      funext k
      fin_cases k
      · exact congrFun ih 1
      · exact congrFun ih 2
      · exact congrFun ih 3
      · have e := (hu (i + m + 4) (Nat.le_add_left ..)).1
        have e' := (hu (j + m + 4) (Nat.le_add_left ..)).1
        simp only [f, funext_iff, Fin.forall_iff, Subtype.mk.injEq] at ih
        simp only [Nat.add_sub_assoc, Nat.reduceSub, Nat.reduceLeDiff, Nat.reduceLT, ih] at e e'
        exact Subtype.eq (Int.cast_injective (e.trans e'.symm)))
  refine ⟨i, j - i, Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hij, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hn
  simpa only [f, Nat.add_right_comm i m (j - i), Nat.add_sub_of_le hij.le] using
    (congrArg (fun g => (g 0).1) (eqs m)).symm

name: putnam_1964_b2
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  simp only [ne_eq, ← Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty] at *
  rw [← Nat.mul_right_cancel_iff Nat.two_pos,
    Nat.two_pow_pred_mul_two Fintype.card_pos, Nat.mul_comm, ← Fintype.card_set]
  apply (Set.Intersecting.is_max_iff_card_eq hPP).mp
  clear hPP
  grind [Set.Intersecting]

name: putnam_1995_a3
proof:
theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  have swap (a b : Fin 9 → ℤ) (i : Fin 9) :
      digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then b j else a j) =
        b i * 10 ^ i.1 - a i * 10 ^ i.1 + digits_to_num a := by
    apply eq_add_of_sub_eq
    simp only [hdigits_to_num, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ite_mul, ite_sub,
      sub_self, Fintype.sum_ite_eq']
  intro d e f h i
  have hd := ((hrelation d e).mp h.1).2
  have he := ((hrelation e f).mp h.2).2
  simp only [swap] at hd he
  have hs := Finset.dvd_sum (fun j (_ : j ∈ Finset.univ) => hd j)
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
    ← congrFun hdigits_to_num e, ← congrFun hdigits_to_num d, Fin.sum_const] at hs
  have hc : IsCoprime (7 : ℤ) 10 := ⟨3, -2, rfl⟩
  apply (hc.pow_right (n := i.1)).dvd_of_dvd_mul_right
  convert dvd_sub hs (dvd_add (dvd_add (hd i) (he i))
    (dvd_mul_right (7 : ℤ) (digits_to_num d))) using 1 <;> ring1
